contract_nodes.CONTRACT_BASELINE_CONTROL: Same key, side, fold, data hash, code hash and capital contract control.

contract_nodes.CONTRACT_SIDE_ACCOUNT: LONG and SHORT remain separate books; account, symbol and position side are explicit and inverse-LONG inference is forbidden.

CAPITAL_METRIC_REPLAY.rule: Replay the coherent schedule because capacity or rejected adds can change later actions. Signal timestamps may be reused only after an exact schedule-fingerprint equality proof; fills, capacity, drawdown, return, TIM and B&H comparisons are always recomputed.

CONSERVATIVE_COHERENT_BUNDLE.rule: Unknown/guard interaction: fail closed and retest the complete bundle.

CROSS_CUTTING_BUNDLE.rule: A regime, alignment, risk or otherwise unclassified guard can alter several action families. Retest the complete coherent bundle.

ENTRY_AND_DOWNSTREAM.rule: Entry population changed: all exit, reentry, exposure and sizing measurements using those entries must be recomputed.

EXIT_REENTRY_BUNDLE.rule: Retest with the frozen entry control and paired reentry obligation; an exit cannot be ranked independently of what reopens afterward.

FAMILY_AND_DOWNSTREAM.rule: Retest every sub-setting in the family and every coherent bundle that consumes its actions.

GLOBAL_CONTRACT_ALL.rule: Freeze a new campaign; every prior cell is stale.

REENTRY_CYCLE.rule: Recompute the whole entry→exit→reentry cycle. Reentry changes the population subsequently seen by exits, including persistent exit-price/top reclaim violations.
